Jordan (AE): Heads-up — AuroraGrid CISO put the POC on hold. Blocking asks: (1) BYO-KMS with attestation, (2) a hard demo start date next Tue, (3) an explicit latency SLA for the demo. Need exec alignment and a short options doc. @Priya @Ibrahim :warning:
Priya (Solutions): TL;DR: Fast path is Dedicated + temporary managed-KMS + IP allowlist — demo in ~3 business days. Full BYO-KMS + attestation for Private will take ~10-12 business days. We should offer a phased plan: demo fast, swap to BYO-KMS mid-pilot with a target swap date.
Marta (Legal): I'll draft BYO-KMS contract language and a 1-page attestation addendum. Also need the customer's security questionnaire so we can map answers and attach evidence links. ETA for draft: EOD tomorrow.
Ibrahim (Eng-Infra): Connector note: we can ship a containerized connector + mutual TLS auth. Hardening + smoke tests ~6-8bd. BYO-KMS HSM handshake adds ~2bd. If they accept a managed-KMS concession for the demo with a guaranteed swap date, we can meet their start date.
Jordan (AE): Customer requested a demo SLA: p95 < 500ms for short-chat flows and p50 < 200ms. They also want a fallback rule: switch to int8 model if p95 > SLA for two consecutive 1-minute windows.
Priya (Solutions): I'll prep an options one-pager with cost delta and SLA/fallback rules. Will include two fallback models and expected token cost delta. Targeting a 30-min exec sync at 4pm PT. Can everyone make it? :calendar:
Ibrahim (Eng-Infra): I'll validate connector ETA and post a short runbook snippet before 3pm PT. Quick example config for fallback policy to include in runbook:
```
fallback:
  trigger: p95_ms > 500 for 2 windows
  action: switch_model rwd-small-int8
```
ops-bot: Note: egress peering request will need ASN and authorized IPs from AuroraGrid. Ops owner assigned: Casey.
Marta (Legal): Action items from legal side: 1) BYO-KMS clause + attestation addendum (EOD tomorrow), 2) questionnaire mapping template (I'll paste a skeleton in-thread).
QA-Bot: Reminder: include proof artifacts (SOC2 link, latest pen-test summary) when returning questionnaire answers.
Jordan (AE): Action items: 1) Priya to produce exec one-pager with costs + SLA fallback (due 3:30pm PT), 2) Ibrahim to confirm connector ETA and infra delta (due 3pm PT), 3) Marta to draft BYO-KMS clause (EOD tomorrow), 4) Ops to request ASN/IP from customer (Jordan to ask).
Priya (Solutions): Roger. I'll slot the exec sync at 4pm PT and paste the slide link after prep. If we can offer a firm swap date to BYO-KMS, we keep them in the pipeline.
Ibrahim (Eng-Infra): Quick feasibility spike running now. Will post a short note with risks and ETA by 2:50pm PT.
Jordan (AE): Thanks team. Keeping updates in-thread — I'll paste meeting notes after the sync. Please don't create parallel threads. :lock:
